rationale: Counts at 02:00 on Nov 7: 66 of 2,410 passengers (2.7 percent) and 15 of 980 crew (1.5 percent).
New cases fell from 22 on Day 5 to 9 on Day 6 and 3 so far on Day 7.
Ill food employees remain off duty; no new food employee case since Nov 5.
fields.authorityRequests: The Vessel Sanitation Program asked the line to arrange cleaning and disinfection in the terminal before boarding.

conditions.condition: Terminal cleaning and disinfection complete and signed off
Ship cleaning schedule complete for cabins on Decks 6 to 9
Guest letter and hygiene notice sent to arriving guests

reconsiderIf: Any new case in a food employee after 06:00
A request from the Vessel Sanitation Program to delay
A cleaning step not signed off by 10:00
